messages:
Maria (Marketing): ok team — we need a lean one-pager for platform/security buyers that ties together SLAs, deployment modes, and a short benchmark narrative. goal: field-ready asset for webinar follow-ups and inbound routing.
Aj: on it. do we want 1-pager focused on tradeoffs (hosted vs dedicated vs private) or more on security + SLA guarantees?
Maria (Marketing): lead with security + compliance as the hook, then a small decision grid for deploy modes, and a 2-line benchmark callout showing typical p95 latency and $/k tokens for each mode. concise.
Kevin: i can pull recent perf numbers from the runtime team — have p95 and 99 latency, throughput, and cost delta for quantized vs full-precision. will need 48h.
Elaine: legal/security will need exact wording for "SLA-backed" and any specific compliance claims (SOC2, ISO). pls route the draft to me before publishing.
Tyler: for the webinar pipeline, recommend a CTA that captures platform size and compliance needs so we can route to sales vs solutions. sample form fields: company size, infra preference, compliance needs, timeline.
Samir: small suggestion — include a one-line checklist for procurement (e.g., data residency, KMS, audit logs) to reduce back-and-forth with enterprise buyers. makes it easier for AE handoff.
Aj: drafting in thread — here's a first pass headline + bullets: 
"Redwood Inference — Secure, Predictable Inference for Enterprise"
- Security-first: VPC/private control plane, KMS/HSM integrations, audit logs.
- SLA options: hosted (best-effort), dedicated (SLA: 99.9% uptime, latency SLOs), private (enterprise contract + customizable SLAs).
- Deployment guide: when to pick hosted vs dedicated vs private (1-line each).
- Benchmark snapshot: p95 latency / throughput / cost callout with small bar.
- Next steps: request a security pack or schedule a private demo.
Maria (Marketing): this is a good shape. can you add a 1-sentence benchmark narrative: "In our tests with conversational models at 2,048 tokens, dedicated shows ~45% lower p95 latency than hosted at scale, and private deployments enable specialized quantization with up to 3x cost savings."
Aj: added. also drafting an elevator paragraph for the webinar intro: "Join us for a 30-min look at how teams move from prototype to production inference with consistent latency and predictable cost — plus a live comparison across deployment modes."
Kevin: FYI numbers i'm pulling: hosted p95 ~210ms, dedicated p95 ~120ms (same model, batched), private quantized p95 ~140ms but 60% cheaper on token cost for tail workloads. will confirm.
Elaine: once Kevin confirms, mark any numeric claims as "typical results" and include footnote linking to the benchmark lab methodology. that reduces legal friction.
Tyler: inbound routing — propose the following mapping: demo requests with "compliance=yes" -> solutions engineering; "infra=private" -> enterprise sales; small startups -> self-serve AE queue.
Samir: add a "SLA decision flow" micro-graphic: quick Qs that steer buyers (latency sensitivity, regulated data, throughput needs). we can embed in the one-pager.
Maria (Marketing): visuals — marketing will produce a small 2-column layout: left = security + compliance bullets; right = deployment decision grid + benchmark callout. can design in Figma by EOD tomorrow if copy is frozen.
Aj: i'll drop the full copy in a gdoc in 2 hours. tagging copy reviewers: @Elaine @Kevin @Samir.
ops-bot: calendar created: "Webinar: Secure Inference for Platform Teams" — Wed 10am PT (30 min). link: https://meet.example/webinar-0423 (invite sent). :calendar:
Kevin: quick note — include one benchmark caveat: "results vary by model family and sequence length; refer to our benchmark appendix for full configs."
Maria (Marketing): good call. also include a short customer quote slot — can we pull a line from fintech pilot about latency and data controls?
Tyler: I'll coordinate with AE to get a 1-liner. routing rules ready once we have the final CTA.
Aj: pushing draft gdoc now: https://docs.example/d/onepager-draft (please comment inline).
Elaine: will do a compliance pass tomorrow morning.
Maria (Marketing): perfect. goal = final-ready one-pager + webinar landing copy by EOD Friday. small checklist: 1) confirm numbers (Kevin) 2) compliance text (Elaine) 3) visual design (marketing) 4) routing rules + form fields (Tyler).
Samir: noted. i'll also prepare a 1-slide benchmark summary to use in the webinar deck.
Maria (Marketing): thanks all — wrapping up here. any blockers?
Kevin: none after i finish the runs.
Aj: none. will ping when draft is updated.
Elaine: none.
Tyler: none. ready for routing test once copy is final.
ops-bot: thread archived to channel topic: marketing/one-pagers (automated).
